name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: fd2_ game prefix; tick_summon_anim domain (per-tick summon-spell animation state machine); variant_d is the variant letter (file has variants a/b/c/d/e plus main/minor, this is dispatch-table idx 7); 3slot = the 3 active sprite slots iterated in the TICK loop (for i in 0..2), even though INIT seeds 4. The 'd' and '3' are semantic (variant letter + active-slot count), NOT Ghidra address residue. Consistent with sibling fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_a_6slot / _b_6slot / _e_16slot in the same file.
purpose: Per-tick state machine for the variant-D summon-spell animation (3 active sprite slots), dispatched as entry idx 7 of the 10-entry summon-spell tick table; returns a frame-hold / done status code consumed by the caster's dispatch loop.
logic_summary: Copies the 10-entry int32 per-color row y-offset rodata table into a local; if the caster is on the enemy team (runtime_char.bTeam==0) shifts every local offset by +0x82. Then dispatches on state_code: state 0 (INIT) seeds 4 slots (frame_counter[i]=-3*i staggered, color_idx[i]=i), sets color_rotation_counter=4, clears terminate_flag and odd/even toggle, returns 2; state 3 returns 0x20 (hold); state 6 sets terminate_flag, returns 0x10 (hold); states 2/5/8 (TICK) flip the mod-2 odd/even toggle then iterate the first 3 slots: blit current frame when 0<=frame<5 at origin_y+local_offset[color_idx], and on even ticks only advance the frame counter, fire a frame-1 chime (slot 0 via fd2_play_sfx_with_handle, slot 1 via fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank, slot 2 silent), set done_flag at frame 2, and at frame 7 rotate the color (counter+1 mod 10, copy into slot color_idx, reset slot frame to 0) unless terminate_flag is set; returns done_flag. All other states return 0.
signature: int fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_d_3slot(uint32 caster_unit_id, uint32 sprite_handle, uint32 origin_y, uint32 row_stride, uint32 state_code)

params.reason: Matches usage as the sprite handle argument to the blit; no address residue.

params.reason: Accurately names the base y origin; no address residue.

params.name: row_stride
params.semantics: Destination row stride passed to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite.
params.reason: Matches usage as the row-stride blit argument; no address residue.

params.name: state_code
params.semantics: Dispatch selector chosen by the caster's animation loop (0=init, 3/6=hold phases, 2/5/8=tick frames, others=noop).
params.reason: Accurately names the state-machine selector; no address residue.

returns.semantics: Frame-hold / status code for the dispatch loop: 2 on INIT, 0x20 on state 3, 0x10 on state 6, done_flag (0 or 1; 1 once a slot reaches frame 2) on tick states 2/5/8, 0 for any other state.
